# openbao

OpenBao, a Vault-compatible server, with its KV mount initialised.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the OpenBao Helm chart. Required. |
| kvPath | string | `"secret"` | Mount path of the KV engine this lab writes under. |
| kvVersion | one of "v1", "v2" | `"v2"` | KV engine version.  An enum though the API takes a string, because mounting a v2 engine and addressing it as v1 succeeds and stores the wrong shape — nothing notices until a reader gets an envelope where it expected a value.  |
| namespace | string | `"openbao"` | Namespace the server runs in. |
| secretNamespace | string | `"external-secrets"` | Namespace the token Secret is written to. |
| storage | string | `"1Gi"` | Size of the volume the file backend writes to. |
| tokenSecret | string | `"openbao-token"` | Secret the init Job writes the scoped token into.  Read by whatever authenticates to this store. It lands in `secretNamespace`, which is usually the external-secrets namespace rather than this one.  |
